A Thousand Cuts.description: At 10th level, once per day the dervish can double the total number of melee attacks she makes during a full attack action, whether or not she is performing a dervish dance. When combined with the dervish dance, she may deliver up to two attacks between each required movement. She also benefits from the Great Cleave feat with slashing weapons while using this ability, regardless of prerequisites, and need not move 5 feet before making any of the bonus attacks it provides. A haste spell can still grant an additional attack while this ability is active, but the spell's bonuses do not stack with those provided by this class feature.

AC Bonus.description: A dervish receives a defensive bonus to AC provided she wears no armor or only light armor and does not carry a shield. This bonus applies even to touch attacks and when the dervish is caught flat-footed. The bonus is lost if the dervish becomes immobilized or helpless, dons armor heavier than light, uses a shield, or bears a medium or heavy load.

Dance of Death.description: Beginning at 4th level, a dervish gains the benefit of the Cleave feat whenever she is performing a dervish dance, even without meeting the normal prerequisites. The usual requirement to move 5 feet before making the extra attack from this ability does not apply.

Dervish Dance.description: A dervish can enter a state of fluid, deadly motion a limited number of times each day. During this dance, she may execute a full attack action using only melee attacks while also moving up to her full speed. She must travel at least 5 feet between each individual attack, and she may not immediately re-enter a square she has just left (though she can return to it later in the same full attack). Attacks of opportunity can still be provoked while dancing, but the dervish may use Tumble checks as part of her movement. If her movement is interrupted, the remaining attacks in the full attack are also lost. While wielding a slashing weapon during the dance, she receives a bonus to attack and damage rolls starting at +1 at 1st level, increasing by +1 at each subsequent odd-numbered level. The dance can only be performed with slashing weapons (if using a double weapon or multiple weapons, all must be slashing type). It cannot be used while wearing armor heavier than light or while using a shield. During the dance, the dervish is unable to employ skills or abilities requiring concentration or stillness, such as Move Silently, Hide, or Search. However, a dervish who has bardic music may sing while dancing, and the Combat Expertise feat can also be used during the dance. The dance is incompatible with any rage or frenzy effect. Only one dervish dance can be performed per encounter. Its duration equals 1 round per two ranks the character has in Perform (dance). When the dance concludes, the dervish becomes fatigued for the rest of the encounter (this penalty is removed upon reaching 9th level).

Elaborate Parry.description: Starting at 7th level, a dervish receives an additional +4 bonus to AC whenever she opts to fight defensively or use the total defense action in melee.

Fast Movement.description: Starting at 2nd level, a dervish receives an enhancement bonus to her movement speed. Wearing armor heavier than light or carrying a medium or heavy load negates this benefit.

Improved Reaction.description: At 6th level, a dervish receives a +2 bonus to initiative checks.

Movement Mastery.description: A dervish possesses such confidence in her physical movements that unfavorable circumstances do not hinder her. She can take 10 on Jump, Perform (dance), and Tumble checks even when stress or distractions would normally make this impossible.

Slashing Blades.description: For a dervish, the scimitar counts as a light weapon instead of a one-handed weapon for all purposes, including two-weapon fighting.

Spring Attack.description: Upon reaching 3rd level, a dervish receives the Spring Attack feat as a bonus, regardless of whether she meets its prerequisites.

Tireless Dance.description: Upon reaching 9th level, the dervish is no longer subject to fatigue at the conclusion of a dervish dance.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency.description: This prestige class does not grant proficiency with any weapons or armor.

However, the dervish must move a minimum of 5 feet between each attack when using this ability, and she cannot return to a square she just exited (though she may return to that square later during her full attack). A dervish prevented from completing her move is also prevented from fi nishing her full attack. She cannot perform a dervish dance in any armor heavier than light or if she is using a shield. A dervish dance lasts 1 round for every two ranks of Perform (dance) that the character has.
